tagline: Leader in tax-advantaged health savings account administration and consumer-directed benefits
hero_kpi_rationale: The HSA Assets KPI is the Hero because it represents the company's core business and its leading position in health savings account management. With $36.5 billion in assets under management as of January 31, 2026, it is the key metric reflecting growth in the tax-advantaged healthcare services market and market share capture (20% of the HSA market measured by assets).

kpis.name: HSA Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed in Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
kpis.description: HSA Assets represent the company's primary business activity

kpis.name: Total Accounts Managed
kpis.explanation: Total number of accounts managed, including HSAs (10.6 million) and complementary Consumer-Directed Benefits (CDB) accounts (7.2 million)
kpis.description: Total Accounts represent all accounts managed by the company

kpis.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Total balance of cash and cash equivalents available
kpis.description: Cash and cash equivalents represent the company's ability to meet its short-term obligations and fund growth activities
kpis.signal: Strong liquidity for operations and investments

risks.title: Tax Reform
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly exposed to changes in the tax advantages of HSAs and CDBs, which could have a significant impact on its business. The language used in the report is very clear about potential risks.

risks.title: Partner Failure
risks.score_rationale: The failure of a partner could have a significant impact on the company, including loss of trust and reputation.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the HSA and CDB market is high and competitors have substantial resources to develop new products and services.

risks.title: Decline in Interest Rates
risks.score_rationale: A decline in interest rates could reduce the company's revenues and make it more difficult to maintain competitiveness.

risks.title: Technology and Data Security Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's increasing use of technology creates data security and privacy risks, particularly critical in the healthcare context.

risks.title: Changes in the Healthcare Industry
risks.score_rationale: Changes in the healthcare industry could impact demand for the company's products and services.

risks.title: Loss of Customer Trust
risks.score_rationale: Loss of customer trust could have a significant impact on the company's business and its ability to maintain market share.

ai_positioning.summary: The company HQY does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
